name: PeerSpot

sources.title: PeerAnalyst free review program — 'Not Listed? Getting Listed Is Easy': request a listing and PeerSpot sets up the product profile at no cost
Vendor page — sales-led programs (review capture, content, demand gen); PeerSpot is the validated review provider for AWS and Google Cloud Marketplaces
Review site homepage — enterprise-tech categories (security, cloud, data, dev tools, CRM, etc.)

conditions: Product profile creation is free — request a listing at getreviews.peerspot.com and the PeerSpot team sets it up at no cost
The platform is built for enterprise/B2B technology products reviewed by verified practitioners — consumer apps and non-tech products don't fit the category catalog
Vendor-paid programs (review acceleration, content, demand gen) exist but are not required for the basic profile
requirements: A B2B/enterprise technology product that maps to a PeerSpot category (cybersecurity, cloud, data management, dev tools, enterprise apps, networking, etc.)
Reviews are 'validated' — real practitioners with verifiable product experience; the free PeerAnalyst flow (peerspot.com/interviews/new) walks a real customer through a 5–10 min AI-guided review
Vendor contact route is sales-led (book a demo / talk to the team) for the paid programs
preparation: Product name, category fit within PeerSpot's enterprise taxonomy
2+ real customers willing to spend 5–10 minutes on a verified review (PeerAnalyst link or voice AI 'Samantha')
Company contact email for the listing request
workflow: Check whether the product already has a peerspot.com profile
If not, request a listing via getreviews.peerspot.com — PeerSpot creates the profile free
Once live, invite identified customers through the PeerAnalyst review link (peerspot.com/interviews/new)
Verified reviews build out the public profile; paid vendor programs are optional upgrades
watchFor: Enterprise taxonomy — a generic consumer SaaS may have no category; check category fit first
Reviews require real practitioners — fabricating reviews violates the verification model and is easily flagged
The batch's submission URL (company.peerspot.com) is the sales-led vendor marketing site, not a submit form
Third-party sources claim manual review in ~3–7 days; not confirmed on PeerSpot's own pages
countsAsLive: The product has a public profile page on peerspot.com under its category, reachable from category browse/search
unknowns: Exact listing-request form URL/turnaround (the 'Request a Listing' mechanism on getreviews.peerspot.com)
Whether a profile with zero reviews stays live and indexable
Link treatment on live product pages
